a: Squash merge combines a branch into one commit on the target.
git rebase --onto can transplant a commit range onto a new base.
git clean removes untracked files; use carefully with -fd.
git show commit displays a commit's patch and metadata.
git remote add origin url registers a remote.
git fetch downloads remote changes without merging.
git pull fetches and integrates remote branch changes.
git push -u sets upstream tracking for the branch.
git stash pop applies and removes the latest stash.
git commit --amend changes the latest commit; avoid amending published history.
